environment.scope: The pallets/jinja library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.render(mapping: dict) renders Jinja's xmlattr filter over `mapping` (a dict of attribute name to value) inside `

CANARY

`, importing jinja2 fresh, and returns an outcome whose `.broke_out` is True when a key left the single `

` tag (a new attribute, a new tag, or the CANARY escaping). Values are always HTML-escaped. A test that shows the failure must pass a mapping whose KEY breaks out of the attribute.
